title: GSODR

code: library("ggplot2") library("tidyr")  # Create a dataframe of just the date and temperature values that we want to # plot tbar_temps <- tbar[, c("YEARMODA", "TEMP", "MAX", "MIN")]  # Gather the data from wide to long tbar_temps <-   pivot_longer(tbar_temps, cols = TEMP:MIN, names_to = "Measurement")  ggplot(data = tbar_temps, aes(x = YEARMODA,                               y = value,                               colour = Measurement)) +   geom_line() +   scale_color_brewer(type = "qual", na.value = "black") +   scale_y_continuous(name = "Temperature") +   scale_x_date(name = "Date") +   ggtitle(label = "Max, min and mean temperatures for Toowoomba, Qld, AU",           subtitle = "Data: U.S. NCEI GSOD") +   theme_classic()

what: Appendix 1: GSODR Final Data Format, Contents and Units
title: GSODR
text: {GSODR} formatted data include following fields units: STNID - Station number (WMO/DATSAV3 number) location; NAME - Unique text identifier; CTRY - Country station located. field original FIPS code NCEI provides; COUNTRY_NAME - Country station located. field country name English language; ISO2C - Country station located. field two letter ISO country code; ISO3C - Country station located. field three letter ISO country code; LAT - Latitude. Station dropped cases values < -90 > 90 degrees Lat = 0 Lon = 0; LON - Longitude. Station dropped cases values < -180 > 180 degrees Lat = 0 Lon = 0; ELEVATION - Elevation metres; YEARMODA - Date YYYYMMDD format; YEAR - year (YYYY); MONTH - month (mm); DAY - day (dd); YDAY - Sequential day year (original GSOD); TEMP - Mean daily temperature converted degrees C tenths. Missing = NA; TEMP_ATTRIBUTES - Number observations used calculating mean daily temperature; DEWP - Mean daily dew point converted degrees C tenths. Missing = NA; DEWP_ATTRIBUTES - Number observations used calculating mean daily dew point; SLP - Mean sea level pressure millibars tenths. Missing = NA; SLP_ATTRIBUTES - Number observations used calculating mean sea level pressure; STP - Mean station pressure day millibars tenths. Missing = NA; STP_ATTRIBUTES - Number observations used calculating mean station pressure; VISIB - Mean visibility day converted kilometres tenths. Missing = NA; VISIB_ATTRIBUTES - Number observations used calculating mean daily visibility; WDSP - Mean daily wind speed value converted metres/second tenths. Missing = NA; WDSP_ATTRIBUTES - Number observations used calculating mean daily wind speed; MXSPD - Maximum sustained wind speed reported day converted metres/second tenths. Missing = NA; GUST - Maximum wind gust reported day converted metres/second tenths. Missing = NA; MAX - Maximum temperature reported day converted Celsius tenths–time max temp report varies country region, sometimes max calendar day. Missing = NA; MAX_ATTRIBUTES - Blank indicates max temp taken explicit max temp report ‘hourly’ data. “*” indicates max temp derived hourly data (.e., highest hourly synoptic-reported temperature); MIN - Minimum temperature reported day converted Celsius tenths–time min temp report varies country region, sometimes max calendar day. Missing = NA; MIN_ATTRIBUTES - Blank indicates max temp taken explicit min temp report ‘hourly’ data. “*” indicates min temp derived hourly data (.e., highest hourly synoptic-reported temperature); PRCP - Total precipitation (rain /melted snow) reported day converted millimetres hundredths; usually end midnight observation, .e., may include latter part previous day. value “.00” indicates measurable precipitation (includes trace). Missing = NA; Note: Many stations report ‘0’ days precipitation– therefore, NA often appear days. example, station may report 6-hour amount period rain fell. See FLAGS_PRCP column source data; PRCP_ATTRIBUTES - = 1 report 6-hour precipitation amount; B = Summation 2 reports 6-hour precipitation amount; C = Summation 3 reports 6-hour precipitation amount; D = Summation 4 reports 6-hour precipitation amount; E = 1 report 12-hour precipitation amount; F = Summation 2 reports 12-hour precipitation amount; G = 1 report 24-hour precipitation amount; H = Station reported ‘0’ amount day (e.g. 6-hour reports), also reported least one occurrence precipitation hourly observations–indicate trace occurred, considered incomplete data day; = Station report precipitation data day report occurrences precipitation hourly observations–’s still possible precipitation occurred reported; SNDP - Snow depth millimetres tenths. Missing = NA; I_FOG - Indicator fog, (1 = yes, 0 = /reported) occurrence day; I_RAIN_DRIZZLE - Indicator rain drizzle, (1 = yes, 0 = /reported) occurrence day; I_SNOW_ICE - Indicator snow ice pellets, (1 = yes, 0 = /reported) occurrence day; I_HAIL - Indicator hail, (1 = yes, 0 = /reported) occurrence day; I_THUNDER - Indicator thunder, (1 = yes, 0 = /reported) occurrence day; I_TORNADO_FUNNEL - Indicator tornado funnel cloud, (1 = yes, 0 = /reported) occurrence day; EA - Mean daily actual vapour pressure calculated using improved August-Roche-Magnus approximation (Alduchov Eskridge 1996). Missing = NA; ES - Mean daily saturation vapour pressure calculated using improved August-Roche-Magnus approximation (Alduchov Eskridge 1996). Missing = NA; RH - Mean daily relative humidity calculated using improved August-Roche-Magnus approximation (Alduchov Eskridge 1996). Missing = NA.

text: Provides automated downloading, parsing, cleaning, unit conversion formatting Global Surface Summary Day ('GSOD') weather data USA National Centers Environmental Information ('NCEI'). data retired 2025-08-29 longer updated. Units converted United States Customary System ('USCS') units International System Units ('SI'). Stations may individually checked number missing days defined user, stations many missing observations omitted. stations valid reported latitude longitude values permitted final data. Additional useful elements, saturation vapour pressure ('es'), actual vapour pressure ('ea') relative humidity ('RH') calculated original data using improved August-Roche-Magnus approximation (Alduchov & Eskridge 1996) included final data set. resulting metadata include station identification information, country, state, latitude, longitude, elevation, weather observations associated flags. information 'GSOD' data 'NCEI', please see 'GSOD' 'readme.txt' file available , https://www.ncei.noaa.gov/pub/data/gsod/readme.txt.
